paragraphs.text: A bakery in the old quarter has never placed an advertisement. It sells one kind of bread, baked twice a day, and usually sells out by four in the afternoon. Customers often queue along the street.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The owner has refused several offers to open branches, saying that the oven and the water of this district cannot be copied. Her daughter, who trained as an engineer, now works in the bakery.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: It sells one kind of bread, baked twice a day
items.prompt: The bakery sells several kinds of bread.

explanation.en: The bakery sells one kind of bread → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Наубайхана бір ғана нан сатады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Пекарня продаёт один сорт хлеба → FALSE.

items.quote: usually sells out by four in the afternoon
items.prompt: Bread is usually still available in the evening.

explanation.en: It usually sells out by four → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Түстен кейін төртке дейін нан бітеді → FALSE.
explanation.ru: К четырём хлеб обычно заканчивается → FALSE.

items.quote: The owner has refused several offers to open branches
items.prompt: The owner turned down chances to expand.

explanation.en: “refused several offers to open branches” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «refused several offers to open branches» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «refused several offers to open branches» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.

items.quote: Her daughter, who trained as an engineer, now works in the bakery
items.prompt: The daughter will take over the bakery.

explanation.en: The daughter works there, but taking over is not mentioned → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Қызы наубайханада жұмыс істейді, бірақ ісін тапсыру туралы ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Дочь работает в пекарне, но о передаче дела ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.
